settings.text: We use 100% grass-fed & grass-finished, pasture-raised beef liver from Tasmanian farms that meet strict animal welfare and food safety standards.

settings.repere: Texte · The liver is trimmed, gently cleaned, …
settings.text: The liver is trimmed, gently cleaned, and frozen shortly after harvest to maintain freshness and nutrient quality.
